title: No hold-by-hold sense of time cost anywhere — status only gives a realm-wide '~300 turns straight, many times that for everything', so budgeting turns across 6 hollows, 4 companion arcs, and the capital was pure guesswork; I ended up skipping the Saltkerns hold and most of Wardmoor's side quests on a turn-budget guess alone.
